sections.heading: SpineCare Connect Myth vs. Fact Matrix

rows: Myth: Specific miracle diets or supplements can repair damaged spinal nerves.
Fact: No food or supplement restores neural connectivity. Nutrition supports overall metabolic health, wound healing, and recovery.
Myth: Using a wheelchair means complete loss of independence.
Fact: A wheelchair is an empowering mobility tool that enables active community living, work, and personal autonomy.
Myth: Everyone with an SCI follows the exact same rehabilitation plan.
Fact: Rehabilitation must be highly individualized based on injury level, completeness, health status, and personal goals.
Myth: Complete SCI means no recovery or adjustment is possible.

Fact: While neurological recovery below the lesion level in AIS Grade A complete injuries is typically limited, individuals gain significant functional independence, practical skills, physical adaptive capabilities, and quality of life through structured, multidisciplinary rehabilitation.

source_notes: The source presents myths and facts as a two-column matrix table; the table format is preserved as the original structure rather than being split into separate myth/fact objects.
